structuralFindings: TO (tour-operator) rate confirmed to be almost exactly Base x 0.80 across every occupancy/meal-plan cell checked (e.g. Ocean View Suites 2 Adults Half Board: 490 -> 392 = 80.0%; Ocean Penthouse 4 Adults Half Board: 1099 -> 879 = 80.0%; Birds Villa 4 Adults Breakfast: 709 -> 567 = 80.0%, rounding to nearest dollar) — i.e. this is functionally an 'STO 20%' rate in CLAUDE.md's tier terminology, though the source document itself never uses the word 'STO'.

Three room categories, each a genuinely different pricing SHAPE: Ocean View Suites (max 3 pax, priced per 1/2/3-adult occupancy plus 3 mixed adult+child combos), Ocean Penthouse (min 4 - max 8 pax, priced per headcount 4 through 8, plus a flat child 4-9yr rate), Birds Villa (same min4-max8 shape as Penthouse). Penthouse and Birds Villa are NOT per-room flat rates — they scale per additional adult even within their minimum-4 baseline.

All three meal plans (Breakfast / Half Board / Full Board) are fully priced side-by-side for every occupancy count — base meal plan is effectively 'Breakfast' (BB) with HB/FB as clearly delineated upgrade tiers, not supplements added on top.

Children policy is unusually generous: 0-3 free, and children AGED 4-9 have their OWN flat per-person rate (not a % of adult) only on Ocean Penthouse and Birds Villa; children 10+ are simply charged full adult rates — no 4-9 child rate exists on Ocean View Suites at all (it instead uses mixed adult+child occupancy combos, e.g. '2 Adults & 1 child', '1 Adult & 1 Child', as distinct priced rows).
Taxi transfer price list is a flat menu (Mombasa Airport, Diani Airstrip, SGR), not scaled by season or tier — same across base and TO documents.
